reviews.text: It is the most difficult choice to make, having to euthanize our beloved Machs, because he became aggressive and attacked us and others with bites. Thank you very much to those of you who welcomed us and took care of us in a professional and understanding way. It makes it easier to live through the grief and loss. Regards Anne & Magne

Professional, calm, empathetic in dealing with animals and their owners. For us, it was by far the worst choice a dog owner could ever have to make. We were given clear information and updates about what was going to happen, and did happen, and were given all the time we needed to get through it.

Thank you so much for the wonderful help today! The two staff members who welcomed us were incredibly nice, caring and professional. They took great care of my cat and made me feel safe in a difficult situation. I am very grateful for all the help we received. Highly recommended!
The best dyreklinikk i Oslo. Very happy and grateful for the help and support to my cat Buli .thank you from my heart
The Vet was very helpful and knowledgeable. Thanks for the help.
They know what they are talking about here. Nice and helpful

Got an emergency appointment when my cat had been in a fight. Fantastically nice staff, professional and explained well what he was doing and what was important afterwards. Nice experience for both people and animals. Recommended.
Perfectly located for public transport around the house. Nice building. The animal clinic also has a larger sales area and a pharmacy next door. There is some parking in the area.

Here you are warmly welcomed, they are quick to help when needed and go out of their way for both your animal and you! :) Skilled veterinarians and the people at the reception are always just as nice to chat with!! :)

Terrible treatment of my dog. Demanding payment for a treatment that made things much worse. Was at the doctor for only a few minutes. Realized that something was wrong. Used the medicine for a few days, which made things much, much worse. Went to a new doctor who concluded that the medicine that was prescribed should never have been given. Sent an email where I explained. Also called to speak, unfortunately I was told by an employee on the phone that according to the medical record it did not look like anything wrong had been done. Fortunately I have pictures before and after treatment. Shaken and extremely upset.

Checked our five-month-old Flat Coated Retriever for a urinary tract infection today. I didn't take the time, but I definitely think the consultation took a maximum of 15 minutes. The examination was performed during regular working hours on a weekday. The vet quickly felt the stomach area (no ultrasound) to detect possible irregularities in the bladder and brought a urine sample for analysis. The price tag was NOK 2685. I have inquired with other dog owners who have had similar treatment performed at other vets and have been confirmed that the price level is too high and far above a level I believe is acceptable. I have nothing against the vet, but am critical of how roughly the chain charges. I have been recommended several vets in the Oslo area who are skilled and much lower priced. I will not use Empet again.
